config.script:
function=self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Function").getChild("Dropdown").props.value
	packageContentVariable=''
	if function=="Cartoner":
		packageContentVariable="PackageContent"
	elif function=="CasePacker":
		packageContentVariable="PackageType"
	
	tagPaths=["[FMC1]FMC/Functions/GetNextBatch/FromEIM/LotData/LotNumber",
	"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/GetNextBatch/FromEIM/LotData/PartNumber",
	"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/GetNextBatch/FromEIM/LotData/StationRecordID",
	"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/GetNextBatch/FromEIM/RecipeParams/"+function+"_PackageType",
	"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/GetNextBatch/FromEIM/RecipeParams/Cartoner_"+packageContentVariable]
	
	result=system.tag.readBlocking(tagPaths)
	
	##load original values
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("ShippingLot").getChild("TextField").props.text=result[0].value
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Part Number").getChild("TextField").props.text=result[1].value
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Station Record Id").getChild("TextField").props.text=result[2].value
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Package Type").getChild("RadioGroup").props.value=result[3].value
	
	##send message to dock to reload the package content
	payload={"msg":result[4].value}
	system.perspective.sendMessage("ReloadPackageContent", payload)

import time
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("ShippingLot").getChild("TextField").props.text=""
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Part Number").getChild("TextField").props.text=""
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Station Record Id").getChild("TextField").props.text=""
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Allocation").getChild("RadioGroup").props.value="Commercial"
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Package Type").getChild("RadioGroup").props.value="One Pack"	
	system.perspective.closeDock("BuildRecords")
	system.perspective.closeDock("EditRecords")
	time.sleep(1)
	self.session.custom.Records=[]

import time
	import json
	##Reset Warning Labels
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Warning Labels").getChild("Missing Shipping Lot").position.display=False
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Warning Labels").getChild("Missing Part Number").position.display=False
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Warning Labels").getChild("Missing Station Record").position.display=False
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Warning Labels").getChild("Content Rows").position.display=False
	
	##Gather Data
	ShippingLot=self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("ShippingLot").getChild("TextField").props.text
	PartNumber=self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Part Number").getChild("TextField").props.text
	StationRecordId=self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Station Record Id").getChild("TextField").props.text
	Allocation=self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Allocation").getChild("RadioGroup").props.value
	PackageType=self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Package Type").getChild("RadioGroup").props.value	
	Content=self.session.custom.Records
	edittedContent=[]
	for element in Content:
		edittedContent.append('"'+str(element)+'"')
	
	##Find how many content rows are present
	lenContent=len(Content)
	
	##Data Inspection
	InspectionResult=[0,0,0,0]
	
	if ShippingLot==None or ShippingLot=="":
		self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Warning Labels").getChild("Missing Shipping Lot").position.display=True
	else:
		InspectionResult[0]=1
	if PartNumber==None or PartNumber=="":
		self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Warning Labels").getChild("Missing Part Number").position.display=True
	else:
		InspectionResult[1]=1
	if StationRecordId==None or StationRecordId=="":
		self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Warning Labels").getChild("Missing Station Record").position.display=True
	else:
		InspectionResult[2]=1
	if lenContent==0:
		self.parent.parent.getChild("Wrapper").getChild("Col1").getChild("Warning Labels").getChild("Content Rows").position.display=True
	else:
		InspectionResult[3]=1
		
		
	if 0 not in InspectionResult:
		
		##load tags
		loadPaths=["[FMC1]FMC/Functions/CreatePackageRecords_Cartoner/ToEIM/AllocationType",
		"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/CreatePackageRecords_Cartoner/ToEIM/LotNumber",
		"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/CreatePackageRecords_Cartoner/ToEIM/PackageRecords",
		"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/CreatePackageRecords_Cartoner/ToEIM/PackageType",
		"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/CreatePackageRecords_Cartoner/ToEIM/PartNumber",
		"[FMC1]FMC/Functions/CreatePackageRecords_Cartoner/ToEIM/StationRecordID"]
		loadValues=[Allocation,
		ShippingLot,
		system.util.jsonEncode(edittedContent),
		PackageType,
		PartNumber,
		StationRecordId]
		system.tag.writeBlocking(loadPaths, loadValues)
		
		function="CreatePackageRecords_Cartoner"
		##trigger  tag
		triggerPaths=["[FMC1]FMC/Functions/"+function+"//Handshaking/cStartCall"]
		##reset
		system.tag.writeBlocking(triggerPaths, [0])
		#time.sleep(1)
		##trigger
		system.tag.writeBlocking(triggerPaths, [1])
		
		
		
		system.perspective.openPopup("Pop1", "FMC_Screens/Pop_Ups/Results Box",showCloseIcon=False,title="",
		resizable=True,modal=True,draggable=False,overlayDismiss=True,params={"Type":"Create Packaging Record","Result":False,"Function":function})
